newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Unidare says finance director resigns.
newsitem.headline: Unidare says finance director resigns.

text.p: Unidare Plc said on Tuesday that its finance director Peter Gray will resign from the company with effect from June 30.
It said Gray is resigning to take up another position and the company will announce his successor in due course.
Gray joined the company as finance director in 1991 having trained with Stokes Kennedy Crowley & Co.
Before joining Unidare he was Finance Director of Food Industries Plc and chief financial officer of Elan Corporation Plc. -- Dublin newsroom + 353 1 676 9775
